name: Kajji real TUI startup across stress and real repositories

description: Baseline: fixed real TUI startup on stress and copied real repository

asi.hypothesis: Establish comparable fresh-process baseline before changes
asi.observations: Real fixture is stable at 3.37s; stress samples range 966–1282ms. Tests and typecheck pass.

description: Parse only new bookmark stream lines instead of reparsing the full prefix

asi.hypothesis: Incremental bookmark parsing reduces repeated allocations for large bookmark streams
asi.rollback_reason: Primary startup increased 24.6%; both workloads worsened. First-frame delay also increased, so environmental variation may contribute; no measured benefit.
asi.next_action_hint: Investigate startup import cost and subprocess critical path rather than parser micro-optimizations
asi.implementation: Maintain pending incomplete line plus immutable concatenated bookmark batches; retain final authoritative parse.
